copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English

howto.what: 把技术话题拆成大白话,按人物、事件、地点、原因、时间五个角度讲清楚。
howto.when: 当用户要求用大白话解释某个技术概念,或评论“太技术了”想弄懂时触发。

say.text: 帮我用大白话解释什么是 API,讲清谁用、在哪用、为什么用。
say.note: 触发该技能,Claude 会按五个 W 拆解。

say.text: 这个 Docker 是什么?用简单话说说它解决什么问题、何时用。
say.note: 它会给出通俗版要素分析。

say.text: 用普通人的话讲一下 GPT 模型,包括谁做的、何时出现。
say.note: 按参与方和时间等维度说明。

howto.what_en: Breaks down technical topics into plain English, covering the who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — typically asking about the who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: Explain what an API is in plain English, covering who, where, and why.
What is Docker in simple terms? Tell me the problem it solves and when to use it.
Describe GPT for a layperson, including who made it and when it appeared.
